name: Starcrash Sight
description: Chart where a star would fall and read every foe and ally standing near the mark.

name: Starcrash Pierce
description: Drive a falling needle of starlight through the guard and into the foe's core.

name: Starcrash Mend
description: Let a gentle fall of starlight close a grave wound in yourself or an ally.

name: Starcrash Cleanse
description: Wash a tide of starlight through the blood and carry a deep taint out of yourself or an ally.

name: Starcrash Volley
description: Loose a great volley of falling stars that all strike the foe within a single breath.

name: Starcrash Cover
description: Spread a deep dome of starlight over yourself and your allies that takes the heaviest blows.

name: Starcrash Sweep
description: Sweep a long bright arm of falling stars across the whole field and strike all in it.

name: Starcrash Surge
description: Pour a surge of starlight into every ally near so each burns with strength for a long span.

name: Starcrash Leap
description: Cross the field in a single bright leap and arrive where the star must fall.

name: Starcrash Beam
description: Lay one beam of starlight on the exact point where the foe must fail past any guard.

name: Starcrash Judgment
description: Pass the judgment of the falling star across the field so every foe is scorched.

name: Starcrash Descent
description: The school's closing move that marks the field in starlight and brings the star down upon it with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Starcrash Doom
description: Bring one whole star down upon the field at the destructive ceiling of its tier.
